<a id="architecture"></a>

## Architecture

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| principles | The composer gate stays: a human draft is never typed over or cleared. What changes is that pij can recognise its OWN leftover by exact content it recorded, and that a hold is bounded, cheap and visible. The sender is told; nothing waits silently. Reads before reserves: inspect the composer through the control-mode capture (no launch) and only reserve when submittable. |
| composition_root | — |
| contracts | — |

<a id="risks"></a>

## Risks

| id | text | check |
| --- | --- | --- |
| rk-0001 | Own-text recognition clears a human's text. | Exact recorded content only; any difference is a human draft; test with one extra keystroke. |
| rk-0002 | Failing a control command loses a needed compaction. | The sender is told by name and can resend; the seat is unblocked. |
| rk-0003 | Canaries cost quota and leak seats. | At most 4 canary Claude seats, each closed and its window killed. |
